confirmed_blocking.summary: Figma, image and text-only requests have no activation path that creates the saved design context; UI-design routing needs that context.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: Preflight step 6 (line 52) activates and records design context only for a Pen implementation reference. Worktree step 3 (line 76) moves pending context only for active Pen work. Line 92 RESOLVEs figma only 'when a Figma source is recorded', and line 117 routes only when 'a saved design context' records the source. Nothing records it for a non-Pen source. spec-builder.md:44 writes source_kind: text into a context that does not exist for non-Pen runs. Breaks FR-005 (Constitution I). ENG-15.
confirmed_blocking.fix: In preflight, activate and persist design context (source_kind, source reference, scope) for Pen, Figma, image and eligible text-only requests, including references first found later in the run. Move that context into factory/design/context.json at worktree creation for every design run, not only Pen. Keep pen-design resolution for Pen only.

confirmed_blocking.summary: The implement step has no relay or resume handling for the ui-designer's requires_user scope questions.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: ui-designer.md:22 must return requires_user: true questions for a missing target and shared-component scope changes (FR-017, missing-target edge case). SKILL.md implement section (lines 117-123) handles only partial returns. The needs_input relay (line 84) is wired only for spec-builder stages. protocol relay step 5 respawns the same role for the same stage but carries no assigned task boundary. Violates Constitution IV. ENG-15.
confirmed_blocking.fix: In SKILL.md step 6, handle needs_input from ui-designer through the protocol relay. Persist the answers outside transient relay state (decisions or design context). Respawn the same role with the same contiguous task range and the settled answers.

confirmed_blocking.summary: A text-only restyle can never reach verified/done: its mapping and fidelity gates are not_applicable, but verified requires all gates passing.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: Line 7 and line 92 require text-only mapping and fidelity to be not_applicable with reason 'no design reference' (FR-015). Line 96: 'Only all passing gates set implementation status verified.' ui-designer.md:27 requires 'design gates verified or an explicit scoped waiver' for done. An ordinary text-only run needs an unnecessary waiver. ENG-15.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Define verified as: every applicable gate passing, and every legitimately not_applicable gate carrying its required reason. Align the done condition in ui-designer.md:27 so text-only runs do not need a waiver.

confirmed_blocking.summary: ui-agent quality-pass edits happen after the last gate verification and batch commit, with no required commit and no gate re-run, so the reported evidence goes stale.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: Step 4 (line 24) commits each passing batch and step 5 validates gates. Line 26 then runs ui-agent and records applied recommendations without requiring a commit, evidence invalidation, or re-running mapping/fidelity/build gates. design-code-mapping.md says code changes invalidate evidence; FR-023 requires current evidence. Constitution IV. ENG-26.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Commit the applied quality-pass changes with their recorded outcome as one tested unit. Invalidate the affected evidence and re-run the applicable gates and build/tests before reporting done.

confirmed_blocking.summary: The ui_agent_pass marker is persisted only after the pass runs, so an interruption mid-pass makes a resumed role run the pass again.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: Line 26 checks ui_agent_pass, runs ui-agent, then persists ui_agent_pass. A deadline stop, crash or kill after the pass starts but before persistence leaves the marker unset, so a fresh role runs the pass again. Violates FR-024 and SC-004. ENG-26.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Persist a durable reservation (for example ui_agent_pass with a started/in-progress state) before invoking ui-agent. On resume, finish or report the reserved pass instead of starting a new one.

confirmed_blocking.summary: Routing mixed runs into contiguous role spans conflicts with code-build's unchanged contract to process the whole task list.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: SKILL.md:117 says 'Limit each spawn to its assigned contiguous run', but line 119 passes no boundary input. Unchanged code-build.md:31 starts at the first unfinished unit of the whole tasks.md, and line 40 defines done as every box checked. A code-build span before a [UI] span implements the [UI] tasks itself or cannot report done at its boundary. Breaks FR-006.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Pass an explicit assigned task range to code-build (and ui-designer). Update code-build.md's work and done rules to honour that range when given, and leave non-design runs unchanged.

confirmed_blocking.summary: An installation with only a Figma MCP server cannot satisfy the Figma capability resolution and is blocked before tasks.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: FR-008 requires resolving a figma skill or MCP capability through RESOLVE. verbs.md defines RESOLVE only as a path to a SKILL.md or SpecKit command file. Every adapters/*/harness.md RESOLVE row searches filesystem skill directories only. An available Figma MCP with no figma skill is treated as missing.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Define a harness-neutral capability-discovery rule for a Figma MCP (verbs.md plus the adapter mappings, or an explicit rule in SKILL.md/design-code-mapping.md). Specify what is handed to the ui-designer when the capability is an MCP rather than a skill path. Keep existing skill resolution unchanged.

confirmed_blocking.summary: The new evidence-path containment check (is_relative_to on the resolved design root) has no test.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: cmd_drop refuses a map reference resolving outside factory/design/ (traversal or symlink escape). tools/tests/test_drop.py adds only the existing-files and missing-file cases; neither fails if the is_relative_to condition is removed. ENG-1.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Add drop tests for a '../' traversal reference and for a symlink inside design/ pointing outside it. Each asserts a non-zero exit, the reference named in stderr, the map unchanged, and factory/ not moved.

advisory.summary: ENG-31: live end-to-end validation of the ui-designer flow is deferred. The constitution requires it before the flow is relied on. The approver must see it run or explicitly accept the deferral; no waiver granted.
advisory.fix: Before relying on the flow, run and record live trials (UI-design run with Pen plus one non-Pen source, mixed-run routing, interrupted-then-resumed implement), add a ui-designer subsection to DESIGN.md 'Validation plan', or have the approver explicitly accept the deferral.
